name: wecut

tools.name: wecut_doctor
tools.description: Check that FFmpeg is installed and has what WeCut needs (libass, xfade, an H.264 encoder). Run once before the first render.

tools.name: wecut_probe
tools.description: Duration, width, height, fps, rotation and audio for video, image or audio files in the workspace. Use the durations for clip from/to.

tools.name: wecut_validate
tools.description: Check a project against the media without rendering. Returns the finished duration and size, or every error with a JSON pointer (e.g. /clips/0/to) and a hint on how to fix it.

project.description: The WeCut project (format "1") as a JSON object. wecut_schema has the full format; wecut_example shows working projects.

projectFile.description: Instead of project: path of a project .json file inside the workspace.

tools.name: wecut_preview
tools.description: Render a few still frames (540p JPEG) at chosen times of the finished video and return them as images, so you can check framing, text size and captions before rendering. Also saved under out/preview/.

at.description: Times in seconds of the finished video. Default: 10%, 50% and 90%.

project.description: The WeCut project (format "1") as a JSON object. wecut_schema has the full format; wecut_example shows working projects.

projectFile.description: Instead of project: path of a project .json file inside the workspace.

tools.name: wecut_render
tools.description: Render the project to output.file (MP4 or GIF) inside the workspace, overwriting an earlier render with the same name. The result is checked with ffprobe. Sends progress notifications when the call has a progressToken.

preset.description: draft = 540p fast check, final = default, high = slower and sharper.

project.description: The WeCut project (format "1") as a JSON object. wecut_schema has the full format; wecut_example shows working projects.

projectFile.description: Instead of project: path of a project .json file inside the workspace.

tools.name: wecut_list
tools.description: Names usable in a project: text styles, caption styles, fonts, transitions, filters, effects, motions, ratios and text animations.

tools.name: wecut_schema
tools.description: The JSON Schema of the WeCut project format, with a description of every field. what=recipe gives the recipe (template) format instead.

tools.name: wecut_example
tools.description: A complete working project to copy from: podcast-clip (cuts + karaoke captions + ducked music), slideshow (photos with motion and transitions) or product-promo (contain + blur, logo, text). Omit name to list them.

tools.name: wecut_analyze
tools.description: Measure a video that worked: shots and pace, cuts in the first 3 s, flashes, beat and tempo, pauses, a silent platform outro, and (with a transcript) words per minute and the hook's words. Returns a sheet of frames, one per shot, as an image: look at it for the headline card, text style, framing and captions. Use the result to pick or write a recipe.

tools.name: wecut_recipe_list
tools.description: Recipes are templates: the shape of an edit without its content (sections such as hook and body, text slots, caption and music style). Lists the built-in ones and the workspace's own (recipes/*.json).

tools.name: wecut_recipe_show
tools.description: A recipe in full, with the roles its clips can feed, its text slots, and its default music.

tools.name: wecut_recipe_apply
tools.description: Turn a recipe plus new material into a project: clips (each with an optional role such as hook or body), words for the text slots, a transcript for captions, and music (replaces the recipe's own track; "none" drops it). Returns the project (saved with write); then wecut_preview and wecut_render it.

role.description: Section it feeds; default body (or the last section).

music.description: Audio file, a video whose sound is used, or "none".

recipe.description: Built-in name, workspace .json path, or a recipe object (wecut.recipe/1).

transcript.description: Word timings of captionSrc (or of the source used longest).

tools.name: wecut_recipe_from_project
tools.description: Make a reusable template from a finished project: sections, transitions, text slots (current words kept as defaults), caption style, effects, and its music as the default track.

project.description: The WeCut project (format "1") as a JSON object. wecut_schema has the full format; wecut_example shows working projects.

projectFile.description: Instead of project: path of a project .json file inside the workspace.

write.description: Save it here, e.g. recipes/my-style.json, so wecut_recipe_list finds it.

instructions:
WeCut edits and renders video on this machine with FFmpeg; nothing is uploaded.
Workspace (every path is relative to it): /pkg
Workflow: wecut_probe the media, write a project (wecut_example shows one, wecut_schema has the format), wecut_validate it, wecut_preview a few frames and look at them, then wecut_render.
Templates: wecut_analyze a video that worked and look at its frame sheet; pick a recipe (wecut_recipe_list) or write one; wecut_recipe_apply it to new clips, words and music; save a finished project as a recipe with wecut_recipe_from_project.
Two clocks: clip from/to are seconds of the SOURCE file; texts, overlays, audio and effects use seconds of the FINISHED video. A transition overlaps two clips and shortens the video by its duration.
Captions: pass word timings (JSON word list, Whisper JSON, SRT or VTT) and set captions.src to the source video so times follow the cuts.
Errors come back with a JSON pointer and a hint; fix the project and call again. Use preset "draft" for quick checks.
